testCase:
S-01: Search with four filters, then the cheapest
Goal: Open the cheapest non-sponsored Stridon running shoe that costs between $50 and $100, is rated 4 stars and up and has fast delivery.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/s-01/
STEP 2: Search for "running shoes"
STEP 3: Under Brand tick "Stridon" (use "See more" if it is not listed)
STEP 4: Set the price range to 50 and 100 and click "Go"
STEP 5: Under Customer Reviews click "4 Stars & Up"
STEP 6: Tick "Fast delivery"
STEP 7: Click the cheapest result that is not marked "Sponsored"
STEP 8: Verify "Cheapest match opened: Stridon Cadence 3 Running Shoes for Men ($67.50)" is visible
